item.title: Oga Aquarium GAO: Cliff-Top Sea Life & Polar Bears — Guide
item.description: Oga Aquarium GAO perches on the cliffs of the Oga Peninsula with a panoramic window overlooking the Sea of Japan, showcasing the rich marine life of the Akita coast alongside polar bears, Humboldt penguins and walruses. The open-ocean tank simulates the rough Sea of Japan, and the naturalistic polar bear habitat allows underwater viewing through a glass tunnel. 🗓️ At a Glance Location Oga, Akita Hours ~9:00–17:00 (seasonal) Admission Around ¥1,200 Time needed About 2 hours Best time Year-round What to See A panoramic window onto the Sea of Japan.

item.title: Oga Peninsula & the Namahage Demons — Akita Guide
item.description: The rugged Oga Peninsula is the home of the Namahage — fearsome demon-masked figures who visit homes on New Year’s Eve to drive out laziness and evil, a UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage. The Namahage Museum and Oga Shinzan Denshokan stage year-round demonstrations, and the February Sedo Festival combines the demons with Shinto fire rituals in deep snow. 🗓️ At a Glance Location Oga, Akita Hours Museums ~8:30–17:00 Admission Museum ~¥600–800 Time needed 1.
